question: Within a single Claude Project, what is the functional difference between project instructions and the project knowledge base?
options: A) Project instructions define behavioral guidance like tone or role, while the knowledge base supplies reference files
B) Project instructions and the knowledge base are simply two names for the same underlying feature
C) Project instructions apply to a single chat at a time, while the knowledge base applies to every project a user owns
D) Project instructions store uploaded files, while the knowledge base only accepts text typed into a settings field
correct_answers: A) Project instructions define behavioral guidance like tone or role, while the knowledge base supplies reference files
explanations: Correct. Project instructions establish behavioral guidelines such as tone or role applied to all chats, while the knowledge base holds uploaded documents, text, and code used as background context.
Incorrect. The two are distinct features serving different purposes: behavioral guidance versus reference content.
Incorrect. Project instructions apply to every chat within the project, not just one, and the knowledge base is scoped to that project, not to all of a user's projects.
Incorrect. This reverses the roles; file uploads belong to the knowledge base, not the instructions field.
